      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {

      "entity": "Finite-element mesh and its mapping to density pixels",

      "effect": "layout"

        "Uniform feasible density throughout the free-design region",

      "effect": "layout"

        "MMA implementation with maximum density move 0.2 and initial asymptote distance 0.5 of the density range"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
